verdict.rationale: A video CPaaS platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as call summaries or quality suggestions, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only sessions, the Media Router, archiving, monitoring callbacks and pricing, with no mention of AI-generated insights or suggestions. Session monitoring callbacks are raw event data, not AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
